DRG Aortic and Heart Assist Procedures Except Pulsation Balloon with MCC matched diagnosis I5043.

Procedures with CC, Inguinal and Femoral Hernia Procedures without CC/MCC, and Inflammatory Bowel Disease without CC/MCC to verify prior authorization, authorization-to-actual alignment, initial and concurrent review performance, discharge planning, and contractual payment accuracy, escalating reimbursement review for materially elevated paid-per-stay cases.

NJ drill context identifies THE CHILDRENS HOSPITAL OF PHILADELPHIA.

Pattern is flagged repeated_delta_concentration and validation_needed.
